title: Cinnamon Twists
description: A soft, buttery treat with a swirl of spiced sweetness — perfect for breakfast or afternoon tea.

ingredients.notes: divided: 30g for Dough, 30g for Filling, 15g for Icing

method.instruction: In a large bowl, combine flour, yeast, salt, and sugar.
In a separate bowl, mix warmed sour cream, 125 ml of the warmed milk, 30 g of the melted unsalted butter, and beaten egg.
Pour wet ingredients into dry ingredients and mix until a soft dough forms.
Knead on a lightly floured surface for 8–10 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Place dough in a lightly greased bowl, cover with a damp tea towel, and let rise in a warm place for 1–1½ hours or until doubled in size.
Punch down the dough and roll out into a large rectangle approximately 30 cm × 40 cm.
Brush the surface with 30 g of the melted unsalted butter.
In a small bowl, mix brown sugar and cinnamon. Sprinkle evenly over the buttered dough.
Fold the dough in half lengthwise, then cut into strips approximately 2 cm wide.
Twist each strip gently and place on a lined baking tray, leaving space between each.
Cover and let rise for 30 minutes.
Preheat oven to 180°C. Bake twists for 12–15 minutes until golden brown.
While twists cool slightly, make the icing: beat together the remaining 15 g of melted butter, vanilla extract, 125 g icing sugar, and the remaining 15 ml milk until smooth and glossy.
Drizzle icing over warm twists and serve.

notes.title: Sour Cream Dough
notes.content: The sour cream creates an exceptionally soft, tender dough. Warming the dairy before adding helps activate the yeast faster — aim for approximately 40°C.

notes.title: Best Served
notes.content: These are best enjoyed fresh and warm on the day they are baked. Store leftovers in an airtight container for up to 2 days. Reheat briefly in the microwave to soften.
